title: File Path Resolver
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Python for Robotics
description: Work out which file a path reaches from a given working directory in eight problems on a small project folder tree, see each step of the resolution, then try your own paths. Used in Chapter 1.

educational.topic: Absolute paths, relative paths and the working directory
learningObjectives: Solve eight path problems by determining which file, or no file, a path reaches from a given working directory, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Carry out the resolution on a visible folder tree, commit an answer, then compare it with the steps the sim took; a free-trial mode resolves any typed path
keyQuestions: Where does a relative path start: at the script or at the working directory?
What is the difference between . and ..?
Why does a path built from __file__ work from any folder?
commonMisconceptions: A relative path starts from the folder the script is saved in
An absolute path depends on the working directory
Code that builds a path from __file__ fails when run from another folder
assessmentOpportunities: Eight committed answers, one attempt each; 7 of 8 for mastery

controls.label: Answer
values: the six files in the tree

controls.label: Check / Next problem / See score / Try again
Click a file in the tree, or the No such file box
